criteria.text: Reserve research quota in web.research.service.ts only when an explicit level is supplied; facts search, autopost and copilot remain available after quota exhaustion, while Need research and Enhance research reserve the explicit level.
Included mode selects provider only from AI_INCLUDED_SEARCH_PROVIDER; changing workspace searchProvider clears searchApiKey and searchEnabled; a Tavily key never reaches api.exa.ai.

All research page loads use constrained static fetch after DNS resolution with private ranges and unsafe redirects rejected; egress policy applies to Exa/Tavily; Wikipedia/Wikidata participate at an explicit level, or an honest defer is recorded.
Deep research can return up to the declared 50 sources, or the specification records an intentionally lower preset.
Ordinary generation reads hashtagInstruction and ctaInstruction from resolvedChannelProfile without contradictory default instructions.
The reproducible read-only Mastra schema fingerprint command is documented and reproduces the dedicated schema digest on the host.
In-memory quota accounting remains explicitly deferred; a Beads task ties durable accounting to or3.9.
Beads tasks record benefit measurement metrics and the owner Exa-key request; m0iy.2 and m0iy.5 close reasons include actual scope.
Handoff and runbook record rollback cc513632d93d, provider wording, transfer terminology, github_sync status, and the related-own-posts 200-character limit.
Three app tsc checks, build, one full pnpm test through record-suite-receipt.sh, process/design guards and empty schema diff pass before any release.
